title: Literal types: which HTTP methods have a body
statement:
1. Опиши `export type HttpMethod` — лише `'GET'`, `'POST'`, `'PUT'`, `'PATCH'`, `'DELETE'`.
2. Напиши `hasBody(method: HttpMethod): boolean` — `true` для `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, інакше `false`.

```ts
hasBody('POST');   // true
hasBody('GET');    // false
hasBody('get');    // ❌ compile error
```
